SINCE 2007 We Provide All Pool Service Needs to the Grapevine, Texas Area Southlake Pools is a family owned and operated business, started in 2007. We’ve learned so much in the 15+ years we’ve been operating. Though we started out as a pool maintenance company, we’ve grown to include pretty much all pool related services, like: pool filter cleaning, acid washes, pool pump repair and replacement, automation repairs and upgrades, leak detection and repairs, and everything from minor pool repairs to complete pool remodels.
